---
title: "Start, stop and check the shop's app"
subtitle: "SOP SYS-03 · Technical systems manual"
---

## Purpose

Start the shop's app on this computer, check that every part of it is
running, and stop it.

## Applies to

The person responsible for the shop's database, at the start of the day,
after the computer restarts, and whenever a screen will not open.

## Before you begin

- **Docker Desktop** is installed and running. Its whale icon appears in the
  Windows taskbar, near the clock. If it is not there, open **Docker Desktop**
  from the Start menu and wait until it says **Engine running**.
- The `.env` file exists in the `dog-groomer-platform` folder. See [SYS-02 Set
  up the AI's API key](ai-key.qmd), steps 8 and 9.

## What the app is made of

Docker runs four parts. Each one is reached at its own address on this
computer only.

| Part | Address | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| **web** | <http://localhost:3000> | The shop's screens: Welcome, Check-in, Calendar and Admin |
| **api** | <http://localhost:8000/docs> | The shop screens' connection to the database |
| **review** | <http://localhost:8501> | The records tool: labelling, AI runs, and the database tests |
| **db** | (none) | The database itself |

The manual is not one of them. It is published on the web; see [SYS-06
Publish the demo and the manual](publishing.qmd).

## Procedure

### Start the app

1. Open a terminal in the `dog-groomer-platform` folder.
2. Type this command and press Enter:

   ```bash
   docker compose up -d --build --wait
   ```

   The first start takes several minutes. Later starts take under a minute.
   The command finishes when every part is running.

### Check that it is running

3. Type this command and press Enter:

   ```bash
   docker compose ps
   ```

   Each of **api**, **review**, **web** and **db** shows **Up** in the
   **STATUS** column. **db** also shows **(healthy)**.

4. Open <http://localhost:3000> in a browser. The Welcome screen opens. The
   first time after a start, it can take up to a minute to appear.

### Stop the app

5. Type this command and press Enter:

   ```bash
   docker compose stop
   ```

   Every part stops. Nothing is lost: the next start picks up where it left
   off.

## Result

The shop's screens open at <http://localhost:3000>, and the records tool at
<http://localhost:8501>.

## If something goes wrong

### localhost refused to connect

That part of the app is not running. Check Docker Desktop is running, then
repeat steps 2 and 3. If one part does not show **Up**, see what it says
with this command, replacing `web` with the part's name:

```bash
docker compose logs web --tail 50
```

### failed to connect to the docker API

Docker Desktop is not running. Open it from the Start menu, wait for
**Engine running**, and repeat step 2.

::: {.callout-warning}
## Never add -v to docker compose down
`docker compose down -v` deletes the database's storage: every dog, booking,
haircut and copy of paperwork recorded in the shop's app. Use it only when
starting over on purpose.
:::
